# Appropriation Ordinance No. 01, Series of 2014

**Pre-Closing Special Budget for Fiscal Year Ended December 31, 2013 — P181,288.77**

## Summary

Enacts the Pre-Closing Special Budget for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2013, appropriating **P181,288.77** sourced from savings overinstalled in the same amount for the [[Municipality of Pitogo]].

Absent: [[Carlos T. Gliane II]].

## Key Provisions

- **Total Appropriation:** P181,288.77
- **Source of Funds:** Savings overinstalled from unexpended appropriations of FY 2013
- **Purpose:** Pre-closing adjustments for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2013

## Entities

- [[Sangguniang Bayan]]
- [[Municipality of Pitogo]]
- [[Paulino S. Sayat]] — Municipal Mayor
- [[Dexter L. Sayat]] — Vice Mayor / Presiding Officer
- [[Municipal Budget Office]]
- [[Municipal Treasurer's Office]]

## Legal Basis

- [[Sec-316-RA7160]] — General limitations on the use of provincial, city, and municipal funds
